incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — HIGH 5xx rate detected in eu-west1 inference-gateway. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 5% (1m). Incident PD12345 :rotating_light:
raj: oncall here, acked PD12345. Triage starting. @mia you're on backup.
mia: looking at metrics — spike started ~02:14 UTC, concentrated on /v1/generate (long prompts).
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by raj.
sarah: support standing by; will prep outreach if customers report.
dmitri: pulling logs from xcom-02/xcom-03 — seeing repeated TCP resets and 502s from model-hosts.
raj: quick mitigation: shifting traffic weight away from eu-west1 to eu-central (10% -> 0%). Applying routing change now.
raj: running quick check: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood-inference/eu-west1/health'``` -> 502 / connection reset.
mia: scaling dedicated pool in eu-west1 (+2 GPUs) and kicking cache-warm jobs for hot prefixes.
dmitri: KV cache eviction spikes correlate with the window — suspect cache churn + upstream socket exhaustion. Increasing cache TTL and warming top prefixes.
sarah: no inbound customer tickets yet; monitoring SLOs for ACME/FinCo and flagging support leads.
raj: note — we deployed optimizer tweak ~3m before spike. Starting canary rollback for model-variant 1.2.4 -> 1.2.3.
incident-bot: Rollback job rb-772 started by raj.
mia: suggest enabling circuit-breaker to fail fast (503) to avoid backend retries amplifying load.
raj: enabling CB with threshold=0.4 and short cool-down.
dmitri: also tuning keepalive and lowering max_sockets on xcom worker to prevent resets. Pushing config now.
sarah: drafting customer-facing blurb: "We're investigating an increase in 5xx errors in eu-west1. Traffic is being rerouted and mitigations are in progress. No data loss expected." Anyone object?
raj: looks good — send if we need to escalate to Tier-1.
mia: cache warming and scale-up complete. KV miss rate dropping.
dmitri: post-rollback logs show upstream connections stabilizing. 5xx rate trending down.
raj: metrics update: error rate down from 6.8% -> 0.9% after routing + rollback + CB. Monitoring for 5m.
sarah: prepping a short status update channel and CC list if we hit 1.5% again.
incident-bot: PagerDuty will auto-escalate in 6m if incident not resolved.
raj: PD12345: setting follow-up tasks: owner=dmitri for postmortem, timeline capture, and revert checklist.
mia: recommending a postmortem hypothesis: cache churn + optimizer build interacting with socket keepalive causing transient exhaustion.
dmitri: saving logs and core dumps to /opt/incidents/PD12345 for analysis.
incident-bot: PD12345 marked RESOLVED by raj. Duration: 7m57s. Auto-note added. :white_check_mark:
sarah: thanks all — quick retro tomorrow 11:00 UTC. I'll ping stakeholders.
raj: closing the loop here. If any regressions, reopen PD or re-route to oncall. Good job team. :thumbsup:
